Advanced Track

Welcome to the **Advanced Track** — the full workshop experience. This track covers all four ggplot2 modules, advanced and interactive plots, ggstatsplot advanced, Quarto for publication, deep statistical analysis, and real-world applied NCTOH healthcare examples.

## 🎯 Workshop Goals - Master all four ggplot2 modules - Build interactive and advanced visualizations - Perform deep statistical analysis with ggstatsplot - Produce publication-ready documents using Quarto ## 📚 What This Track Covers - ⏳ Survival Analysis Workshop — 5 sessions, 5 labs, quizzes, cheat sheet - 📁 R Foundations & Data Wrangling (+ Applied Examples) - 📊 Best Practices & Plot Matching - 🎨 ggplot2 Modules 1–4 (Complete) - 🖼️ Basic, Intermediate & Advanced Plot Gallery - 🔗 Specialized Plots — Merged, Statistical & Interactive - 🧪 ggstatsplot — Intro, Intermediate & Advanced - 📋 gtsummary Tables & Deep Statistical Analysis - 📝 Quarto — Basics, Dynamic Documents & Publication - ⚙️ Full Exporting, Debugging & Advanced Tools - 🏥 Applied NCTOH Healthcare Examples ## 🧭 Find Your Way Around Use the navigation bar above to browse all modules. Key starting points: - ⏳ **[Survival Workshop](survival-workshop/s1_time_to_event.qmd)** — Slides, labs and quizzes on time-to-event data: Kaplan-Meier, log-rank, Cox (start at Session 1) - 📁 **[R Foundations](r-foundations/getting-started.qmd)** — R syntax, wrangling, and full NCTOH applied examples - 📊 **[Data Visualization](data-visualization/ggplot_grammar.qmd)** — All four ggplot2 modules, advanced and interactive plots - 🧪 **[Statistical Analysis](statistical-analysis/statistical_tests.qmd)** — Full ggstatsplot, gtsummary, and deep analysis - 📝 **[Reproducibility](statistical-analysis/reproducible_writing.qmd)** — Quarto basics through publication-ready documents > The complete navbar gives full access to all workshop content. ## 📥 Downloadable Resources All files for this track are available below, grouped by type. ### 📄 R Scripts -
